title: MCP Hello Page
summary: A tutorial or introduction page on Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standard protocol for connecting AI models to external data sources and tools. The article provides a beginner-friendly 'Hello World' style guide to implementing MCP in applications.
problem_solved: Provides developers with a starting point to understand and implement the Model Context Protocol for AI integration.
why_valuable: Offers accessible entry point to MCP, helping developers bridge AI models with external tools and data sources using a standardized protocol.
